body:
Forge Optimization Modpack

This modpack is designed to improve Minecraft Forge performance without changing the vanilla experience. Perfect for players who want higher FPS, faster loading times, and smoother gameplay—especially on low to mid-end PCs.

🔧 What’s included?

Advanced CPU and RAM usage optimization

Improved chunk loading and rendering performance

Reduced lag in large worlds and servers

Bug fixes and overall stability improvements

Compatibility with most popular mods

🎯 Goal:
To deliver a stable and optimized experience while keeping vanilla gameplay intact, allowing you to add your favorite mods without sacrificing performance.

Perfect for survival worlds, technical servers, or simply enjoying Minecraft with the best possible performance.
